name: multcompare
expr: c = multcompare(s); diffs = c(:, 4); rows = size(c, 1); cols = size(c, 2); ord1 = c(1, 1); ord2 = c(1, 2);
comment: Sig: c = multcompare(stats [, alpha [, ctype]]) — pairwise post-hoc comparisons after anova1. Returns K(K-1)/2 × 6 matrix [i, j, lower_CI, mean_diff, upper_CI, p]. v1 ships 'bonferroni' (default) and 'lsd' methods. KNOWN GAP: 'tukey-kramer' HSD requires the studentized range distribution — not yet. anova1's stats struct is also extended in this cycle to populate {means, n, s, gnames, source} fields needed by multcompare. Deterministic integer y/group inputs for parity reproducibility.
